d5_0.jpg.artist: Nam-ho Park from Seoul, Korea
d5_0.jpg.desc: The 4th floor in Korea has the same status as the 13th floor does in the US. The pronunciation for "4" is "sa" which is the same as the Chinese character for "death", hence the "F" instead of "4" in elevators. Quite silly really.

d7_0.jpg.title: File:SM70 portable evacuated tube solar cooker at Porthtowan Beach, Cornwall, UK, in 2015.jpg
d7_0.jpg.desc: This is an evacuated tube solar cooker produced in China, imported into the UK in 2015.  The tube is a glass Dewey vessel - like a Thermos flask, there is a vacuum between the two layers of glass.  Sunlight is concentrated by the reflective parabolic trough shaped wings and strikes the cooking tube.
